releaseNotes: Adds a per-port fresh-identity requirement at physical down/up and explicit connection-session boundaries so stale REST identity cannot immediately re-latch a previous device.
Invalidates only the affected Master REST identity cache on a physical port-down and coalesces reconnect/hot-swap REST refresh requests into one serialized management-plane worker.
When a fresh serial ProductName disagrees with cached REST identity, the stale REST entry is discarded and refreshed before VendorID/DeviceID/PDO capability continue.
Keeps last-known card presentation visible during transition; mapping changes only after fresh identity is verified/published.
Preserves V723 SMC startup presentation replay and does not add periodic identity polling or a second Modbus/ISDU transport path.

en: Fixed live IO-Link device hot-swap/port-cross-swap identity refresh so a replacement device is re-identified without restarting ICEops.
Disconnect/Connect now invalidates only the management-plane identity session cache and requires one fresh serial identity verification before the REST session latch can be reused.
Retains the V723 SMC first-start logo/product-image presentation fix. Polling cadence, SerialCommandQueue, PDO write safety, and IODD download rules are unchanged.
ko: 온라인 상태에서 IO-Link 장치를 포트 간 교차 교체했을 때 이전 장치 매핑이 남고 ICEops를 완전히 재시작해야 갱신되던 현상을 수정했습니다.
Disconnect/Connect 시 표시 중인 카드는 유지하면서 management-plane identity 세션 캐시만 무효화하고, REST 세션 latch 재사용 전에 포트별 fresh serial identity를 1회 검증합니다.
V723의 SMC 최초 실행 로고/제품 PNG 수정은 그대로 유지하며, Polling 주기, SerialCommandQueue, PDO write 안전 경로, IODD 다운로드 규칙은 변경하지 않았습니다.
